title: PaymentRiskEvaluationRecord
description: Schema for synthetic payment risk evaluation and benchmark dataset.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the synthetic transaction (e.g. eval_0001).

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code of transaction origin IP.

customer_country.description: ISO 2-letter country code of customer's registered home country.

velocity_10m.description: Number of transaction attempts in the preceding 10-minute window.

card_exposed.description: Whether the card fingerprint was matched in threat intelligence breach dumps.

exposure_confidence.description: Confidence score of the threat intelligence match (0.0 to 1.0).

exposure_source.description: Threat feed source name (e.g. RedLine_Stealer_Dump, Telegram_Paste, None).

token_active.description: Whether an active vault payment token exists for this card.

token_age_days.description: Age of the payment token in days.

is_zombie_token.description: Whether the active token is linked to an expired, blocked, or replaced card.

card_expired.description: Whether the underlying physical card has passed its expiration date.

device_new.description: Whether the transaction is originating from an unrecognized device ID.

failed_attempts_count.description: Number of historical authorization failures in last 24 hours.

label.description: Ground truth label: 1 = Compromised credential loss / fraud, 0 = Legitimate payment.
